private void rollback(SshTarget target, String current, String operation) {
        ProcessRunner.Result result = ssh(target, String.join(" ",
                "set -eu; old=$(cat", quote(operation + "/previous-target"), "2>/dev/null || true);",
                "systemctl --user stop ji-host.service 2>/dev/null || true;",
                "data=$(dirname $(dirname", quote(operation), "))/data;",
                "before=", quote(operation + "/backups-before"), ";",

"attempts=0; until", quote(current + "/bin/ji-host"),
                "--health-check http://127.0.0.1:$rest/api/v1/health/ready; do",
                "attempts=$((attempts + 1)); test $attempts -lt 30; sleep 1; done;",
                "else rm -f", quote(current), "; fi; fi;",
                "rm -f", quote(operation + "/activated"), quote(operation + "/complete"), ";"),
                COMMAND_TIMEOUT);
        if (result.exitCode() != 0) throw new IllegalStateException("Host rollback failed");
